title: Kinship with Clarence Williams and his health
summary: Foster discovers Claiborne Williams was his uncle and that Clarence Williams is a relative; they talk about Clarence's stroke, shop and marriage.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
